_comment: The stainless steel line: eight stages. Stainless is slow, heavy work - each stage needs far more effort than copper, and each machine supplies 4 work/sec per level. See stations.json for field meanings. 'view' selects this factory's sprites and sign style.

stations.name: Sheet Prep
stations.desc: Unrolls, levels and degreases stainless coil ready for the laser.

stations.name: Laser Cut
stations.desc: A CNC laser cuts shell blanks and port holes with no hand marking-out.

stations.name: Rolling
stations.desc: Programmable rolls form each blank into a true round shell.

stations.name: TIG Weld
stations.desc: Welds the seam and both domed ends under argon. The slowest job in the plant.

stations.name: Coil Fit
stations.desc: Installs the internal heating coil and welds in the connections.

stations.name: Testing
stations.desc: Pressure-tests each vessel and scans every weld automatically.

stations.name: Casing
stations.desc: Injects the light blue insulation and fits the outer casing rings.

stations.name: Packing
stations.desc: Final inspection, then boxed and strapped for the lorry.
